planets.name: TOI-3486 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-3486 with a 2.22-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-3486 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-3486. Its orbit and size follow Yee et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
